items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: I actually spent a week with the Basie band at one point during their off-

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I remember that name now. Mort Lindsey.
Yeah. And that went on for quite a few years. And during that time a lot of things happened. I actually spent a week with the Basie band at one point during their off-

season. But summertime would come and I would take off. At that time I bought property up in the state of Maine, and I sort of discovered a place in the woods where I could sort of set up a fishing camp and I did that every summer. I would take off from about June 20th and I would take at that time my daughter and my ex-wife now up to Maine to this big house that we bought on the oceanfront, which she still owns, and just take the entire summer off. And sometimes I wouldn’t play at all the entire summer, I’d just…
